## Model summary

This section reports a simple regression-style summary using a symptom-free indicator as the response proxy and a small set of covariates from the vaccination and daily survey data.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-model-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of model coefficients"
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

vax = pd.read_csv("covid_vaccination.csv", low_memory=False)
daily = pd.read_csv("covid_daily_survey.csv", low_memory=False)

merged = daily[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "HAD_SYMPTOMS"]].merge(
    vax[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER", "CURRENT_STATE"]],
    on="VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID",
    how="inner",
)

merged = merged.dropna(subset=["age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER", "CURRENT_STATE"])
merged = merged[merged["age_at_vax_yrs"] != "Invalid"].copy()
merged["symptom_free"] = merged["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq("no").astype(int)
merged["age_at_vax_yrs"] = merged["age_at_vax_yrs"].astype(str)
merged["DOSE_NUMBER"] = merged["DOSE_NUMBER"].astype(str)
merged["CURRENT_STATE"] = merged["CURRENT_STATE"].astype(str)

sample = merged.sample(n=5000, random_state=42)

X = pd.get_dummies(sample[["age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER", "CURRENT_STATE"]], drop_first=True)
X = X.astype(float)
X = sm.add_constant(X)
y = sample["symptom_free"]

model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit(disp=False, maxiter=100)

summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "estimate": model.params,
    "std.error": model.bse,
    "statistic": model.tvalues,
    "p.value": model.pvalues,
})
ci = model.conf_int()
summary["conf.low"] = ci[0]
summary["conf.high"] = ci[1]
summary = summary[["estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value", "conf.low", "conf.high"]].round(4)
summary
```

### Interpretation

- The table presents estimated coefficients and uncertainty for a simple covariate-based model.
- The response variable is a symptom-free indicator, used here as a proxy for short-run vaccine outcomes.
- These estimates are exploratory and intended to show how the observed dataset could be summarized in a model-oriented format.
